text:
alex: deploy-bot blocked canary promotion for service 'gateway'
alex: trigger id: build-2026-03-22-07, tag: gateway:staging-20260322
deploy-bot: publish failed: provenance-check error -> missing 'cosign.attestation' annotation in eu-ecr registry :warning:
deploy-bot: error metadata: kms_ttl_expired=true, region=eu-west-1
ingrid: I see the same in the CI logs. Looks like cosign timestamp was generated with an old KMS TTL and got rejected by the regional attestation guard
kevin: is this only for eu-ecr? any other regions affected?
alex: only eu so far. us-east pushed fine and canary went through there
priya: quick question — does deploy-bot fallback to the previous digest or halts the promotion entirely?
deploy-bot: policy=halt_on_provenance_fail unless explicit pin/backfill requested
ingrid: OK. two options: 1) pin the canary to the previous verified digest (manual promote), 2) regenerate attestation with the right KMS TTL and republish (risky during change window)
kevin: I prefer pin to previous digest for now to keep canary running. We can schedule a controlled republish after-hours
alex: agreed. pin back to digest: sha256:7f4a2b... (that's last verified canary digest)
priya: I'll update the release notes and the rollback playbook. Add a note about cosign/KMS TTL so oncall doesn't re-run the same publish ad-hoc
release-manager-bot: reminder: any manual pin/promotion needs changelog entry and customer-facing note only if it impacts API versioning
ingrid: steps I'll take:
- run `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name gateway --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:7f4a2b...` to confirm
- run manual promote: `deployctl promote --service gateway --to canary --image-digest sha256:7f4a2b... --reason "provenance missing in eu, pin previous digest"`
- create a short post in #release-notes with the pin and follow-up task
kevin: I'll open a follow-up ticket to audit cosign invocation in our eu CI workflow — likely TTL arg missing in the cosign sign step
alex: command snippet from CI was:
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/cosign --output-attestation attestation.json build/image.tar
cosign attest --type provenance --attestation attestation.json eu.gcr.io/gateway:staging-20260322
```
alex: need to ensure we pass `--timestamp-ttl` (or whatever our wrapper expects) so KMS stamps are valid for cross-region attestation checks
priya: timeline: we can pin now, promote canary in ~10m, then schedule republish during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window tonight (is that still open?)
release-manager-bot: scheduled change window confirmed: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC
ingrid: pinging @kevin for manual promote permission
kevin: go ahead. I'll watch the canary metrics and be oncall during the post-promote period
alex: promoted manually, deploy-bot acknowledged: canary promotion completed (eu region pinned to previous digest)
deploy-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: recorded
priya: I added to release notes: "Temporary pin of gateway canary in EU due to attestation KMS TTL mismatch. A republish with corrected attestation is scheduled during 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. No customer-facing behavior expected." — cheers :memo:
ingrid: follow-up ticket: INF-8761 "cosign ttl arg missing in eu pipeline" created and assigned to kevin
kevin: thanks. I'll add a unit test to the pipeline so cosign invocation fails early if ttl not set
alex: CI owners FYI: please don't re-run the eu publish until we republish during the window
priya: closing thread for now — will reopen if anything flares during canary
ingrid: thumbs up :thumbsup:
